config.question: Owner 2026-11-01 '这个25是最好的参数？' / '先测门槛稳健性': does the alarm-entry rule give similar results at alarm thresholds next to 25 coins?
config.single_variable: Alarm threshold (distinct same-side 1.618 touches within 5 minutes): 10, 15, 20, 25, 35, 50, 75. Window, entries, exits, fees, slippage and sizing are those of the alarm study's 30-minute hold plan.

variant_notes.near30: near Monday edge, -30 percent (the alarm study's headline rule)

config.score_use: none for entries or exits; the score file only defines the scored first weekly touches, as in the alarm study
config.sizing: monday_limit_return_opt.frac N20 3x through monday_limit_paper_accounts.replay (median over the return-opt seeds), by period
config.fees: Codex config maker 0.02 / taker 0.05 percent (OKX Lv1, read 2026-10-23); 10bp slippage on non-target exits; the entry is a resting limit at the level
config.control: The alarm study's seeded 15 percent sample of touches outside its alarm windows, same rule, no score
config.in_sample: 25 was chosen on 2026-10-27 on the same history; all thresholds here are looked at on that history, so this checks stability, not a new value
